build:example.#: The example components. `cargo test` loads them as fixtures and `zfx --app` runs them; `spawn` resolves a sibling of the root, so they all land in one directory.
build:example.command: mkdir -p out && cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena-cli build examples/zenafx/hello.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/hello.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/hello.wit --world app && ./target/release/zena-cli build examples/zenafx/page.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/page.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/slots.wit --world page && ./target/release/zena-cli build examples/zenafx/card.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/card.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/slots.wit --world widget && ./target/release/zena-cli build examples/zenafx/label.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/label.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/slots.wit --world widget && ./target/release/zena-cli build examples/zenafx/widgets/main.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/widgets.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/widgets.wit --world app
